title: sourceFileParts
responsibility: Splits a committed source path into its literal folder and filename for SourceFileList.

inputs.name: sourceFileParts.path
inputs.description: The path string whose folder and filename are returned. Its exact spelling is preserved except for an exact leading relativeTo prefix; no path normalization occurs.

inputs.name: sourceFileParts.relativeTo
inputs.description: The literal prefix conditionally removed from path. It is matched case-sensitively at the beginning of the string, with no directory-boundary check.

outputs.name: sourceFileParts
outputs.description: The returned folder and name from the path after the exact leading prefix is conditionally removed. Splitting occurs at the last slash; a path without a slash has an empty folder, while an empty path or trailing slash has an empty name.
